title: 第7章 格林家族第8章 胖子山姆
content_zh:
成年意味着你可以去做小时候被禁止的事，比如说喝酒，但也会无法拒绝某些事，比如说被敬酒的时候不好推辞，喝酒的时候也不能怂。
默里·格林知道成年人很难，但也没想到自己成年第一天就如此艰难，当默里·格林从床上爬起的时候，已经是第二天的下午，第三天才完全缓过来。
那天晚上，默里·格林想想都有些后怕，自从格林伯爵等人离开后，大厅中央被男仆收拾出来，原本演奏平缓音乐的乐团，开始演奏舞曲，原本平静的宴会瞬间热闹起来，少男少女们群魔乱舞。
而默里·格林却被一群贵族少女围着喝酒，这具身体虽然以前有过偷偷喝酒的记录，但都是浅尝辄止，结果当晚直接上强度，左一杯，右一杯，被喝断片，不省人事。
按照大哥莱茵·格林的讲述，喝醉了的的默里·格林整个人像是个傻子似的，乖乖的坐在沙发上，木木的，就剩下本能，谁想和他跳舞就能把他牵走，跳完后拉回来，又呆呆的坐在那里，特别好玩。
所以很多贵族少女都来找他跳舞，要不是莱茵·格林掌控全局，盯着他，当天晚上默里·格林就不知道被那个少女牵回家了。
真正做到成年日即成年。
那天晚上，默里·格林不记得自己喝了几瓶酒，也不清楚自己与几个女孩一起跳了舞，他就记得自己喝了很多，想要退席，但是却被安琪拉去跳舞，柔软的触感，迷人的幽香是他最后的记忆。
丢人啊！
成年礼之后几天，默里·格林就待在家里，上午跟着父亲和大哥训练，下午在藏书室与罗伊老师看书，他的表现让罗伊老师很欣慰，还会给他讲一些书上没有的事情，使得默里·格林对这个世界的认知逐渐丰富。
卧室，默里·格林仔细翻看眼前的几张图纸，全是自己这几天亲手设计的枪械图。
“唉！算了，在这个神奇的世界，这些东西都只是玩具。”
轻叹口气，默里·格林将手中的图纸点燃，丢进火盆之中，直至其全部化为灰烬。
处理完图纸后，默里·格林换上一套便服，犹豫一会，对这个世界没太多安全感的他还是打开储物柜，掏出魔晶枪，装进专门设计的枪套中，把枪套系在腰间。
“吉姆，去备一下马车，等会我想去城里一趟。”
“好的，小少爷。”
男仆吉姆快步离去，去安排出行之事。
等默里·格林走出城堡大门时，一辆马车还有两名穿着半身甲的护卫已经等在门口，这是一辆单马四轮马车，黑红色的外观，侧面开门，吉姆打开门，里面是正对的两排沙发车座，默里·格林坐在座位上，闻着才点燃不久的熏香，心旷神怡。
“去山姆酒馆。”
“遵命，驾。”

得到默里·格林的命令，两名护卫立即上马往前开路，绅士打扮的马车车夫手中马鞭轻挥，拉着车的马跑动起来，车顶上代表着格林家族的红黑色烈焰战锤旗飞舞，马车朝着城堡山下跑去。
格林城堡建立在格林城北面的一座矮山之上，不，准确来说，是格林城是围绕格林城堡向南建立的，因为格林领是王国边境。
在北方，边境北面有不同于人族的野蛮兽人，这些野蛮兽人不时会南下打劫，抢劫粮食和人口，所以格林城堡是格林城的第一道防线。
格林城堡的历史比格林家族的历史都还长，已经不清楚几百年了，从建国以来，已经换了好几个贵族，并且重新修建了很多次。
最后两百多年前，铁匠出身的格林先祖带领一起打铁的兄弟，孩子，铁匠铺的学徒，反抗野蛮兽人的入侵，并经过好几年的战斗，得姓格林，成为第一代封地贵族，封号格林男爵，封地格林领，为格林家族奠定了辉煌基础。
后面几代格林男爵也不甘落后，不仅保格林领不失，还主动出兵对抗入侵的野蛮兽人，成功封为格林子爵。
最终上任格林子爵，默里·格林的爷爷，带领他父亲格林伯爵进入北地草原，反攻野蛮兽人，不幸战死。
格林伯爵继位一战功成，将围绕在边境的一个十万人野蛮兽人部落击退，三个万人部落杀崩，拿下它们的土地，封为格林伯爵。
现在的格林伯爵领是原来的一个子爵领，三个男爵领，外加一大片北地草原组成，拥有七座城，三座要塞，是名声响彻整个北地，甚至闻名整个王国的强大新兴贵族。
插着格林家族旗帜的马车在街道上飞驰，所过之处，马车和路人纷纷让路，没有任何阻挡。
通过车窗，默里·格林看向外面的民众，发现他们看着马车的目光充满了崇敬与畏惧，第一次感受到格林两个字带来的震撼，默里·格林心中复杂至极，最后轻声嘀咕道。
“这穿越的姿势真是对了。”
当马车停在山姆酒馆的时候，默里·格林的心情还有些复杂，下了马车，默里·格林抬头看向山姆酒馆，只见其是一座占地三四百米，四层楼高的建筑，在平均只有二层的平民区可谓是鹤立鸡群，显眼至极。
这是胖子山姆的酒馆，胖子山姆是格林伯爵麾下的一名爵士之子，他上面有两个哥哥，而且他大哥目前表现得不错，有机会延续家族席位。
所以当山姆成年后，他父亲分给他一笔钱，三个商铺，最后他把三个商铺全卖了，拉着周围几个朋友，还在默里·格林这里凑了一点钱，买下这座楼，建成了山姆酒馆。
“默里少爷，欢迎光临。”
还没等默里·格林走进山姆酒馆的大门，一名门童两眼一亮，三步并作两步小跑到他面前，一脸谄笑的欢迎起来。
以前默里·格林很不喜欢谄媚之人，但看着对面灿烂的微笑，热情的语气，真诚的眼神，默里·格林发现……真香啊！
“山姆那家伙在哪？”
“老板在四楼休息，我这就为您叫他起来。”

“我自己上去找他就行了。”
默里·格林微微点头，然后摆手拒绝了门童的提议，按照记忆，自己一马当先的走上楼去，后面男仆吉姆掏出一枚银币，抛给那位服务的门童。
“谢谢默里少爷，感谢您的慷慨与大方，祝您玩得愉快。”
山姆酒馆有四层楼，一楼服务平民和小商人，二楼服务大商人或者拥有贵族血脉的人，三楼服务于贵族，四楼是宴会厅，可以举办酒宴，还有一些休息室和山姆的办公室。
此时下午三四点左右，已经有人陆陆续续的过来，基本上是一些谈完或做完事情，过来消遣的小商人，真正的夜生活还没有开始。
content_en:
Being an adult means that you can do things that were forbidden as a child, such as drinking, but you will also be unable to refuse certain things. For example, it is difficult to refuse when being toasted, and you cannot be timid when drinking.
Murray Green knew that being an adult was difficult, but he did not expect that his first day of adulthood would be so difficult. When Murray Green got up from the bed, it was already the afternoon of the second day, and he did not fully recover until the third day.
That night, Murray Green felt a little scared when he thought about it. After Earl Green and others left, the middle of the hall was cleaned up by the valet. The orchestra that originally played gentle music began to play dance music. The originally peaceful banquet suddenly became lively, and boys and girls danced wildly.
Murray Green, on the other hand, was surrounded by a group of aristocratic girls drinking. Although this body had had records of secretly drinking in the past, he had only tasted it briefly. As a result, he went straight to the intensity that night. One drink on the left and one on the right. He was drunk to pieces and fell unconscious.
According to the narration of the eldest brother Rhine Green, the drunk Murray Green looked like a fool. He sat obediently on the sofa, dumb and instinctive. Anyone who wanted to dance with him could lead him away, pull him back after the dance, and sit there blankly again. It was very fun.
So many aristocratic girls came to him to dance. If Rhine Green hadn't taken control of the situation and kept an eye on him, Murray Green wouldn't have been led home by that girl that night.
The day you truly reach adulthood is when you become an adult.
That night, Murray Green didn't remember how many bottles of wine he drank, and he didn't know how many girls he danced with. He just remembered that he drank a lot and wanted to leave the party, but Angela danced with him instead. The soft touch and charming fragrance were his last memories.
Shame on you!
A few days after the coming-of-age ceremony, Murray Green stayed at home, training with his father and eldest brother in the morning, and reading with Teacher Roy in the library in the afternoon. Teacher Roy was very pleased with his performance and told him some things that were not in the books, which gradually enriched Murray Green's understanding of the world.
In the bedroom, Murray Green carefully looked through the several drawings in front of him. They were all drawings of firearms that he had personally designed in the past few days.
"Alas! Forget it, in this magical world, these things are just toys."
With a sigh, Murray Green lit the drawing in his hand and threw it into the brazier until it was all reduced to ashes.
After processing the drawings, Murray Green changed into a set of casual clothes. After hesitating for a while, he still opened the locker without much sense of security in this world, took out the magic crystal gun, put it into a specially designed holster, and tied the holster around his waist.
"Jim, go prepare the carriage. I want to go to the city later."
"Okay, young master."
Jim, the valet, left quickly to make arrangements for the trip.
When Murray Green walked out of the castle gate, a carriage and two guards in half-armor were already waiting at the door. It was a one-horse four-wheel carriage, black and red in appearance, with a side door. Jim opened the door, and inside were two rows of sofa seats facing each other. Murray Green sat on the seat, smelling the incense that had just been lit, feeling relaxed and happy.
"Go to Sam's Tavern."
"As commanded, drive."
After receiving Murray Green's order, the two guards immediately mounted their horses and started to move forward. The carriage driver dressed as a gentleman waved his whip in his hand, and the horse pulling the carriage started to run. The red and black flaming hammer flag representing the Green family flew on the roof of the carriage, and the carriage ran towards the castle hill.
Green Castle is built on a low hill to the north of Green City. No, to be precise, Green City is built around Green Castle to the south, because Green Territory is the border of the kingdom.
In the north, there are savage orcs who are different from the human race on the north side of the border. These savage orcs will go south to rob food and people from time to time, so Green Castle is the first line of defense of Green City.
The history of Green Castle is longer than that of the Green family. It is no longer clear how many years ago it was.Over the past hundred years, since the founding of the People's Republic of China, it has been replaced by several nobles and rebuilt many times.
In the last two hundred years or so, Green's ancestor, who was a blacksmith, led his blacksmith brothers, children, and apprentices in the blacksmith shop to resist the invasion of barbaric orcs. After several years of fighting, he took the surname Green and became the first generation of fiefdom nobles, titled Baron Greene, and the fiefdom Greenland, which laid a glorious foundation for the Greene family.
The following generations of Barons Greene were not to be outdone. Not only did they maintain Green's leadership, they also took the initiative to send troops to fight against the invading barbaric orcs, and were successfully granted the title of Viscount Greene.
He eventually became Viscount Green, Murray Green's grandfather, and led his father, Earl Green, into the Northland grasslands to counterattack the barbaric orcs, but unfortunately died in the battle.
Earl Green succeeded to the throne and succeeded in the first battle, repelling a tribe of 100,000 barbaric orcs surrounding the border, killing three tribes of 10,000 people, taking their land, and naming him Earl Green.
The current Earldom of Green is composed of the original viscounty, three baronies, and a large area of ​​Northland grassland. It has seven cities and three fortresses. It is a powerful emerging aristocracy with a reputation throughout the Northland and even the entire kingdom.
The carriage with the flag of the Green family was speeding down the street. Wherever it passed, the carriage and passers-by gave way without any obstruction.
Through the car window, Murray Green looked at the people outside, and found that their eyes were full of reverence and fear as they looked at the carriage. For the first time, he felt the shock brought by the word "Green". Murray Green felt extremely complicated in his heart, and finally whispered softly.
"This is the right way to travel."
When the carriage stopped at Sam's Tavern, Murray Green's mood was still a bit complicated. After getting off the carriage, Murray Green looked up at Sam's Tavern and saw that it was a four-story building covering an area of three to four hundred meters. It stood out from the crowd and was extremely conspicuous in a civilian area with an average of only two floors.
This is Fat Sam's tavern. Fat Sam is the son of a knight under Earl Green. He has two older brothers, and his eldest brother is currently doing well and has a chance to continue his family seat.
So when Sam came of age, his father gave him a sum of money and three shops. Finally, he sold all three shops, pulled together a few friends around him, and scraped together some money from Murray Green, bought this building, and built Sam's Tavern.
"Master Murray, welcome."
Before Murray Green could walk through the door of Sam's Tavern, a doorman's eyes lit up and he trotted up to him, welcoming him with a smile on his face.
In the past, Murray Green disliked flattering people, but looking at the bright smile, warm tone, and sincere eyes on the other side, Murray Green found...it smells so good!
"Where's that guy Sam?"
"The boss is resting on the fourth floor. I will wake him up for you."
"I can just go up and find him myself."
Murray Green nodded slightly, then waved his hand to reject the doorman's proposal. According to his memory, he walked upstairs at the first step. Behind him, the valet Jim took out a silver coin and threw it to the doorman who was serving.
"Thank you, Master Murray, for your generosity and generosity. I wish you a pleasant stay."
Sam's Tavern has four floors. The first floor serves civilians and small businessmen, the second floor serves big businessmen or people with noble blood, the third floor serves nobles, and the fourth floor is a banquet hall where banquets can be held, as well as some lounges and Sam's office.
At this time, around three or four o'clock in the afternoon, people were already arriving one after another. Basically, they were small businessmen who came to have fun after talking or finishing things. The real nightlife had not yet begun.
